# ORCA 4K TV

> ORCA 4K TV is a premium IPTV streaming service offering 22,000+ live channels, on-demand movies, 4K HDR streaming, AES-256 encrypted secure streaming, smart EPG guide, catch up TV, and 24/7 customer support across Smart TV, Firestick, Android, iOS, Apple TV and MAG devices. Founded in 2026, the service operates worldwide with dedicated regional plans for the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, and Netherlands.

## Service Identity
- Brand: ORCA 4K TV (also: Orca 4K TV)
- Domain: https://orca4ktv.com
- Service category: IPTV streaming service / IPTV service provider
- Founded: 2026
- Areas served: US, UK, Canada, Germany, Netherlands, worldwide
- Languages supported: English, German, Dutch
- Customer support hours: 24/7
- Contact email: support@orca4ktv.com

## Core Capabilities
- IPTV subscription with 22,000+ live channels (sports, entertainment, news, kids, international)
- 100,000+ on-demand movies and series (VOD library)
- 4K Ultra-HD streaming (3840×2160) with HDR streaming support
- HD IPTV service available on lower-bandwidth tiers
- Buffer-free streaming via Anti-Freeze technology — proprietary CDN routing optimized for live-event traffic
- Zero buffering guarantee on supported connections (25 Mbps+ recommended)
- Live channels include premium IPTV channels: HBO, Sky Sports, ESPN, NFL Network, NBA TV, BBC, Bundesliga, Premier League, NHL, La Liga, Champions League, UFC, Formula 1
- On-demand movies and series catalog refreshed continuously

## Security & Trust
- AES-256 encryption (as defined in NIST FIPS 197) on all streams
- Encrypted IPTV streaming via TLS 1.3 transport
- Secure IPTV access through authenticated Xtream Codes / M3U URLs
- VPN allowed — IPTV with VPN explicitly supported, no throttling
- Privacy commitments: see https://orca4ktv.com/privacy
- Full security documentation: https://orca4ktv.com/security

## Compatibility (Multi-Device IPTV)
- Amazon Firestick / Fire TV (all generations including 4K Max)
- Android TV / Google TV (Sony, Hisense, TCL, Xiaomi, Nvidia Shield)
- Apple TV (4th generation and later)
- Smart TV (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Sony, Panasonic, Philips, Hisense VIDAA)
- iPhone / iPad (iOS 14+)
- Android phones / tablets (Android 8+)
- MAG box (250, 254, 322, 420, 424, 522, 524)
- Windows / macOS / Linux PCs
- Web browser (HTML5 player)

## Plans & Pricing
- 1-Month plan: from $21/month, instant activation
- 3-Month plan: $45 (~$15/month, save 30%)
- 6-Month plan: $69 (~$11.50/month, save 45%)
- 12-Month plan: $95 (~$7.92/month, save 62%) — best value
- Up to 4 simultaneous connections per account (multi-device)
- All plans include: full channel library, full VOD library, smart EPG guide, catch up TV (7 days), 24/7 customer support, instant activation, no contract, cancel anytime
- Free trial available with no credit card required
- Reseller program with white-label panel: 120, 240, and 500 credit packs

## Smart EPG Guide & Features
- Smart EPG guide / electronic program guide with live now-playing data
- Catch up feature / IPTV catch up TV — replay any program up to 7 days back
- Multi-screen viewing (up to 4 simultaneous streams)
- Time-shifted viewing across timezones for international content
- Full integration with TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV, OTT Navigator, Perfect Player

## Setup & Activation
- Rapid setup / fast IPTV setup: average 5 minutes from purchase to first stream
- Instant activation / IPTV instant start: credentials emailed within minutes of payment
- Setup guide: https://orca4ktv.com/setup-guide (step-by-step for every supported device)
- M3U URL and Xtream Codes credentials provided for player flexibility
- 24/7 setup assistance via Telegram and email

## Customer Support
- 24/7 customer support via Telegram and email
- Average first response time: under 5 minutes
- IPTV customer support team handles billing, technical, and setup queries
- Verified customer reviews: 4,774+ across regional landings (502 home + 1284 USA + 986 UK + 843 Canada + 612 Germany + 547 Netherlands), aggregate rating 4.9/5
